videos.description: In this talk, Professor Jiang explains what's behind the systems collapse we're witnessing.  He argues that modern systems are inherently fragile, and require redundancy, ductility, and professionalism to maintain.  Because of the aging crisis, financialization, and bureaucratization, people are becoming more apathetic.  Only the worst people rise to the top now, shunning talented visionaries such as Jensen Huang.
